text.description_html:
Deltana CSA12-10B-C, Clearance Finish 12" Solid Brass Window Casement Stay Adjuster

Casement stay adjusters hold casement style windows (windows that swing open) in place at a set opening. Totally adjustable, a tightening knob holds the window in place anywhere on the arm, so it will never wear out and loose friction. This 12 Inch Window Casement Stay Adjuster is made of heavy duty solid brass construction for lasting quality. The contemporary design makes it perfect for any house. It is slim enough that it will not steal the show from the view outside the window, but those who do notice it, will see the sleek style.

Specifications for the Deltana CSA12 12" Casement Stay:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Dark Oxidized Satin Bronze Oil Rubbed
  • Rod Length:12"
  • Rod Diameter: 3/8"
  • Sash Plate: 2-1/4" x 1"
  • Sill Plate: 1-3/4" x 3/4"
  • Includes matching finish screws.
  • Deltana CSA12 Dimensions (PDF)

Clearance Priced. NO RETURNS
